description: Never call a destination safe; give each official source's words. Everything for a trip in one call; send only the parts needed. Destination (country, plus latitude and longitude for weather): official travel advice from the US State Department, UK FCDO and Canada side by side, active disaster alerts, weather risk for the days ahead, CDC travel health notices, public holidays and an exchange rate. Fares (from, plus to or a country): the cheapest round-trip or one-way fares travelers found recently, sorted by price, with dates, airline, stops and booking links (paid links); cached recent finds, not live quotes, and divux never books. Price a plan (legs): send the flights you planned; get the cheapest recent (cached, not live) fare per leg with its find date, the cheapest day around your date, the cheapest month, and a trip total in USD and local_currency. Delays (airports): what the FAA reports right now at US airports: ground stops, delay programs, arrival and departure delays and closures. Use when someone plans or takes a trip ('anything I should know before Lisbon?', 'flights from LA to Tokyo in January?', 'any delays at SFO?'). Facts are dated and linked.

airports.description: US airport codes for the FAA's delays right now, e.g. ['SFO', 'JFK']; an empty list for every US airport with a delay

country.description: Destination country in English or two-letter code, e.g. 'Japan' or 'JP'

depart.description: For fares: departure month YYYY-MM or date YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to start_date

direct_only.description: For fares: true for nonstop flights only

from.description: For fares: departure city or airport code, e.g. 'New York' or 'JFK'

lat.description: Latitude of the place being visited, for weather

legs.description: To price a trip you planned: each flight leg (max 4). Returns cached cheapest fares per leg, by day, and a trip total

lon.description: Longitude of the place being visited, for weather

one_way.description: For fares: true for one-way; defaults to one-way when there's no return

return.description: For fares: return month or date; defaults to end_date; leave both out for one-way

to.description: For fares: destination city or airport code, e.g. 'Lisbon'; defaults to the country's capital

name: check_trip
title: Trip check: destination advice, fares and airport delays
